GRAMMAR 2, 7-UNIT MAShQLAR, 5-BET + REVISION 1-7 (39-bet, PDF 38). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
12-mashq davomi: 2 A: ...... (you/see) Janice at the party? B: No, I ...... (see) her for weeks. 3 A: ...... (Fred/visit) his grandparents in Italy? B: Yes, he ...... (go) to Italy last summer to see them. 4 A: I ...... (eat) at Martin's Steak House last night - the food was delicious. B: That's my favourite restaurant. I ...... (eat) there many times. 5 A: ...... (you/buy) a dress for the wedding yet? B: No, I ...... (not/find) anything that I really like. 8 A: ...... (Sara/come) home from work yet? B: No, she ...... (call) and ...... (say) that she's going to come home late tonight.
13) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect simple, present perfect continuous or the past simple.' SURAT: keksa ayol (Ann Baker). Ann Baker 1) ...... (graduate) from law school in 1962 but she 2) ...... (never/work) as a lawyer. She 3) ...... (decide) to become a science fiction writer because she always 4) ...... (find) stories about other planets fascinating. Ann 5) ...... (write) books for more than fifteen years and so far she 6) ...... (publish) eleven books. She 7) ...... (receive) many awards and one of her books 8) ...... (become) a best seller in 1975. For the last six months Ann 9) ...... (work) on her latest novel which is about a young couple who travel to Pluto.
'Revision: Units 1 - 7':
14) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Do you know ...... Canadian people? A some B a little C many.

O'NG USTUN:
2 ...... they going shopping this afternoon? A Are B Is C Am. 3 "Karen doesn't like watching TV." "Neither ...... Bill." A do B does C is. 4 This puzzle is much ...... than the last one I did. A easy B easiest C easier. 5 Patty ...... the dog when it started to rain. A was walking B walked C walks. 6 If Angie finishes early she ...... go to the party. A is B will C be. 7 Would you like ...... carrot juice? A a few B some C much. 8 Has John finished cooking dinner ......? A just B since C yet. 9 Have you ...... to the new funfair? A been B visited C gone. 10 I ...... work late yesterday. A do B didn't C does. 11 What time do you ...... work? A leave B leaving C leaves. 12 She didn't ...... to go swimming. A use B used C using. 13 This scarf is not as ...... as that one. A cheaper B cheapest C cheap. 14 Sarah will probably ...... us solve the problem. A helped B helps C help. 15 At 8 am last Friday I ...... cutting the grass. A were B was C did.
15) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 Susan love eating fresh bread. → loves 2 "Do you like he?" "Yes, I do." 3 "Did you saw Uncle Bob at the park? 4 She used to worked in a fast food restaurant. 5 Aunt Dora will does the cooking. 6 When my dog sees a cat, it barked. 7 I've just broke my arm. 8 Let's go before it will get dark.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the present perfect simple (continued).
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki present perfect simple shaklida qo'ying (davomi).
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt: last
  night, last summer, this
  morning) yoki PRESENT PERFECT
  (for weeks, many times, yet)?

  2 Did you see (at the party -
    aniq) / haven't seen for weeks
  3 Has Fred visited (tajriba) /
    went last summer
  4 ate last night / have eaten
    many times
  5 Has Mum spoken / called this
    morning
  6 Has Michael bought / hasn't
    saved up yet
  7 Have you bought yet / haven't
    found
  8 Has Sara come yet / called and
    said (tugagan harakatlar)


⚠ 'THIS MORNING':

  Agar ertalab o'tib ketgan bo'lsa
  - Past Simple.


⚠ 'TO SAVE UP':

  = pul jamg'armoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
ANN BAKER - YOZUVChI HAQIDA.

  1 graduated (in 1962 - aniq)
  2 has never worked (tajriba)
  3 decided (o'tgan qaror)
  4 has always found (hozir ham)
  5 has been writing (for more

items.textEn: Ann Baker ___ (graduate) from law school in 1962
but she ___ (never/work) as a lawyer.
She ___ (decide) to become a science fiction writer
because she always ___ (find) stories about other planets fascinating.
Ann ___ (write) books for more than fifteen years
and so far she ___ (publish) eleven books.
She ___ (receive) many awards
and one of her books ___ (become) a best seller in 1975.
For the last six months Ann ___ (work) on her latest novel which is about a young couple who travel to Pluto.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: Susan love eating fresh bread. → loves
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni tuzating, namunadagidek. Namuna: Susan love eating fresh bread. → loves
exercises.explanationUz:
1-7-UNITLAR XATOLARI.

  1 love → LOVES (3-shaxs) - NAMUNA
  2 he → HIM (tushum)
  3 saw → SEE (Did + asosiy)
  4 worked → WORK (used to +
    asosiy)
  5 does → DO (will + asosiy)
  6 barked → BARKS (0-tur - ikkala
    present)
  7 broke → BROKEN (have + V3)
  8 will get → GETS (before dan
    keyin will yo'q)

patterns.formula: Has + KIM + V3 ...? — Yes, ... + V2 + this morning / last summer.
patterns.exampleEn: Has Mum spoken to Jim? — Yes, she called him this morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Oyim Jim bilan gaplashdimi? — Ha, u bugun ertalab qo'ng'iroq qildi.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Umumiy savol - Perfect; aniq vaqt - Past.

patterns.formula: KIM + has been + V-ing + for ... and so far + KIM + has + V3 + SON
patterns.exampleEn: Ann has been writing books for more than fifteen years and so far she has published eleven books.
patterns.exampleUz: Enn o'n besh yildan ortiq kitob yozib keladi va hozirgacha o'n bitta kitob nashr etgan.

patterns.exampleEn: Let's go before it gets dark.
